verification_rule: A VERIFIED claim must name the claim type and include claim-appropriate evidence. Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN.
stale_rule: A recorded claim tied to a repository HEAD, deployment, test run, or evidence artifact is STALE when the authoritative current source no longer matches its recorded identity.
proof_authority: Evidence outranks assertions; current authoritative sources outrank historical records.
freshness_rule: Recorded runtime evidence is CURRENT only when its observed HEAD exactly equals the live authoritative HEAD at claim time. Otherwise it remains HISTORICAL/STALE and cannot certify the current repository.
